description: dry-run validate a Work Breakdown Structure document that the calling agent authored by value, returning every hard-fail error and soft warning without storing anything or invoking any model.
embedding_description: Validate an agent-authored work breakdown structure document before registration. Non-mutating dry run: check process keys against the live registry, RESULT_PROCESSOR_KIND annotations, argument schemas, Composed references, placeholders, and phase containment. Returns errors and warnings; stores nothing.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Validation report with keys: valid, errors, warnings, wbs_id
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Present valid first, then every entry of errors and warnings verbatim — the caller needs the full list to repair the document in one pass.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: If valid is true, the document can be registered. If valid is false, repair the listed errors in the authored document and validate again; warnings are advisory and do not block registration.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Dry-run validating an agent-authored Work Breakdown Structure document. validate_authored_work_breakdown_structure accepts {content, wbs_id, phase_number, manifest_id?}. The document is passed by value; nothing is stored.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: ValidationError: arguments do not conform to the schema (note: document findings are returned in the result's errors list, not raised). ServiceUnavailable: the process discovery service is not available, so live process-key existence could not be checked.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Argument-shape failures: fix the action arguments and resubmit. Discovery unavailability: retry after the platform finishes starting; do not treat it as a document error.
